description: This file contains source code implementing whitespace management in a Git-related project. It includes functions for parsing whitespace rules, checking whitespace in lines, fixing whitespace issues, and generating error messages related to whitespace. It also defines data structures and constants used for managing whitespace rules and behavior.

methods.name: unsigned parse_whitespace_rule(const char * string)
methods.description: Parses a whitespace rule string and returns the corresponding rule bits.

methods.name: unsigned whitespace_rule(struct index_state * istate,const char * pathname)
methods.description: Determines the whitespace rule for a given file path and index state, considering attribute check results.

methods.name: char * whitespace_error_string(unsigned ws)
methods.description: Generates a human-readable error string describing specific whitespace issues based on rule bits.

methods.name: void ws_check_emit(const char * line,int len,unsigned ws_rule,FILE * stream,const char * set,const char * reset,const char * ws)
methods.description: Checks a line for whitespace issues, optionally emitting annotated line segments to a stream.

methods.name: unsigned ws_check(const char * line,int len,unsigned ws_rule)
methods.description: Performs a whitespace check on a line, returning a bitmask of detected issues.

methods.name: int ws_blank_line(const char * line,int len)
methods.description: Returns whether a line is blank (contains only whitespace).

methods.name: void ws_fix_copy(struct strbuf * dst,const char * src,int len,unsigned ws_rule,int * error_count)
methods.description: Copies a line into a strbuf while fixing whitespace issues according to specified rules.

methods.name: unsigned ws_check_emit_1(const char * line,int len,unsigned ws_rule,FILE * stream,const char * set,const char * reset,const char * ws)
